# Manish Bisht

> Staff Engineer with a decade across product, platform, and engineering
> leadership — from founding Run4Offers to leading teams at VideoVerse. Works
> backwards from the customer problem, ships the smallest thing that solves it,
> and builds the engineering rigour to make it last. Currently applying that to
> AI-assisted products and workflows. Based in India (IST).

Personal portfolio at https://manishbisht.me. Static React app on GitHub
Pages. The home page is pre-rendered to HTML at build time, so it is readable
without JavaScript; this file is the condensed text summary.

## Quick facts

- Role: Staff Engineer at VideoVerse (since January 2025; Lead Engineer there
  in 2024). Based in India, works remotely.
- Earlier: Let's Dive (SDE II, 2020–2023), BookMyShow (SDE, 2019–2020),
  Covalent Capital (Software Engineer, 2018–2019), BlueCube Network (intern,
  2016), founder of Run4Offers (2015).
- Specialisms: customer-led product engineering; React, TypeScript, and
  frontend systems (module federation, design systems, Web Vitals); CI/CD and
  monorepo tooling (Turborepo, Nx); applied AI (LLM integration, RAG, MCP
  servers, agentic workflows); engineering leadership (mentorship, RFCs,
  on-call culture).
- Notable results: p95 latency cut 38% on a real-time video editor
  (VideoVerse); BookMyShow checkout re-architected from a coupled monolith to
  a federated platform across six markets; CI build time cut from 14 min to
  2.9 min across a 12-package monorepo; server errors down 94% vs a Q3 2022
  baseline.
- Open source: Google Summer of Code 2017 (phpMyAdmin core); Facebook Open
  Source mentorship 2018 (Facebook Instant Articles).
- Availability: open to staff / principal engineering roles, selective
  freelance, and consulting. Replies within 24 hours.

## Secondary pages

Each is served as a plain HTML page at its own URL, readable without
JavaScript. The app also reaches the same content through a hash route
(/#/work and so on), but the URLs below are the canonical ones.

- [Work](https://manishbisht.me/work/): architecture, performance, and
  shipping at scale.
- [Impact](https://manishbisht.me/impact/): quantified engineering metrics
  from production systems.
- [Writing](https://manishbisht.me/writing/): long-form notes on engineering
  systems, performance, and scaling a team.
- [Testimonials](https://manishbisht.me/testimonials/): verbatim quotes from
  leads and collaborators.
